items.description: Unus2unum is an AI-powered business networking platform based in Clubview, Centurion, built around a private, vetted matchmaking network. Members exchange client referrals, track business introductions and are paired for one-on-one meetings scheduled by the platform's AI, with the stated goal of connecting professionals face-to-face around the world rather than only online. The service runs through two portals: a Business Portal aimed at small business owners, verified professionals and corporate leaders seeking vetted referral partners, and a Student Portal for college and university students, offering a skill-swap board, project rooms, mentoring from senior business figures and a verified 'Rising Star' placement track. New members can start with a 14-day free trial before moving onto an annual membership, with a separate, lower annual rate offered to students. Introduction and referral activity is logged and tracked through the platform itself.

items.description: Uvirco Technologies is the original corona camera manufacturer, supplying corona and ultraviolet discharge-detection solutions to the power industry worldwide. The underlying technology was developed in collaboration with the CSIR and has been available to the market since 1992. Its CoroCAM product line includes handheld cameras such as the CoroCAM 6HD, 7HD and 8HD, plus a UAV-mounted CoroCAM 8HD and the CoroCAM UVS, sized and balanced to fit standard commercial gimbal designs so they can be lifted by enterprise-grade drones. Beyond handheld and aerial units, Uvirco also offers combined ultraviolet, thermal and visible-light detection systems, and makes CoroCAM camera cores available to system integrators who want to build the technology into their own products, including customised versions. The company also runs CoroBASE software and training programmes, and offers a distributor programme for resellers who want to carry its products.

Vacation Centre is a multi-award-winning travel agency offering tailor-made holidays to destinations such as Mauritius, Zanzibar and the Maldives, with a particular focus on Beachcomber's Mauritius resorts. The agency positions itself around first-hand experience of the destinations it sells, sourcing deals from a variety of operators rather than a single supplier, and promises 24/7 personal support to clients. Among its running promotions are an Early Booking Offer for savings on Beachcomber's flagship Mauritius resorts, a Honeymoon Offer with discounts and romantic extras for honeymooners, a Kids Stay Free family package, and a Golf Challenge built around Beachcomber's golf packages. Itineraries are 100% tailor-made, and the agency's own shorthand for the process is that it plans the trip while the client packs.

items.description: Van Heerden Pharmacy is located in the Highlands Centre in Lyttelton, where it provides comprehensive prescription services from a friendly, efficient team. Customers can choose delivery, same-day delivery, in-store pickup or in-store shopping, and the pharmacy also offers delivery for orders placed off-site. Credit card payments are accepted, and the premises include a wheelchair-accessible car park and entrance. The pharmacy trades six days a week, including Saturdays, and aims to keep waiting times short while maintaining a welcoming atmosphere for patients collecting prescriptions or shopping in-store. Its position on the corner of Rabie Street and Glover Avenue in the Highlands Centre makes it a convenient option for Lyttelton residents who need dispensary services and general pharmacy shopping in a single visit.

Van Zyl's Autobody is an insurance-approved, dealer-certified panelbeater on Brander Street in the Jan Niemand Park industrial area, handling collision repairs and spray painting. The workshop says it works with all major and minor insurance companies and repairs all types of vehicles regardless of warranty status. Free estimates and quotations are offered, and customers can book an appointment through the website or by contacting the workshop directly. Repairs carry a two-year workmanship warranty, parts are covered by each supplier's warranty, and paintwork carries a lifetime warranty in line with the paint manufacturer's terms. Opening hours are weekdays from 7:30am to 4:30pm, with the workshop closed on Saturdays and Sundays.

items.description: Vindilac General Suppliers is a South African wholesaler that delivers directly to a site, business or residential address across the country. Its product range spans construction and cleaning materials, catering equipment, stationery, beauty products, home appliances and home decor, so that a single order can cover a wide mix of business and household needs. Depending on the size of the order, the company delivers beyond Gauteng into Limpopo, North West, Mpumalanga and the Free State. It describes itself as considerate of the current economic climate, aiming to supply quality materials at competitive prices, and says its team invests time in understanding each client's specific needs before fulfilling an order. The company also says it continually asks for customer feedback on its service and products, using that input to improve the experience it delivers.

VIP Consulting Engineers brings more than 48 years of experience in the civil engineering field, and says it has completed numerous high-profile projects over that time. Its services cover civil engineering, delivering solutions for infrastructure projects from concept through to completion, and structural engineering, focused on the safety and stability of buildings through expert design and analysis. The firm also offers construction management, overseeing projects for timely and cost-effective completion, environmental impact assessment to evaluate a project's environmental implications, and urban planning aimed at designing sustainable, efficient urban spaces. A further service line is low-cost housing, which the firm describes as delivering safe, quality homes to underserved communities through strong partnerships. The company positions its team as well-versed in current industry standards and best practice, guiding clients from initial consultation through to project completion.

Vision Plastics opened its doors in January 2010 and has grown since then into a supplier of choice in the plastic packaging industry. The company says its roots are in honesty and integrity, preferring to meet customers in person so it can build a personal, long-standing relationship and understand each client's packaging requirements in detail. Beyond supplying locally within South Africa, Vision Plastics has spent more than ten years exporting plastic packaging products to other African countries, working through trusted transport partners to serve the wider pan-African region. The business describes price, quality and service as working together like the three legs of a tripod, arguing that if one is missing the whole offering becomes unstable. That philosophy underpins its approach to building mutually beneficial, long-term relationships with customers so that both sides can grow together over time.

Visto Mouldings is a Jan Niemand Park manufacturer and supplier of skirting boards and architraves in a wide range of profiles, and it can match custom designs for architects, builders and homeowners. Its skirting range includes pine, hardwood, and Supawood and MDF options. Beyond skirtings, the business makes and supplies cornices, decking planks cut from timbers it manufactures itself, laminate and vinyl flooring, cladding and custom blinds, delivering across the whole of Gauteng. It positions competitive pricing and quality as the baseline of its offering, offers factory-direct pricing, and says installation support is available for its skirting products. The company also states that outstanding service is what keeps clients coming back, with its own customers pointing to service as the main reason they stay.

items.description: Vivid Hue is a creative manufacturing and branding studio in Centurion offering CO2 laser cutting and engraving on wood, acrylic and other suitable non-metal materials. It also runs roll-to-roll DTF printing, producing ready-to-press, full-colour apparel transfers for clothing businesses, brands and repeat production runs, alongside a custom apparel service for personal, promotional and team clothing made around a client's own idea. For gifts and keepsakes, the studio offers sublimation printing, full-colour personalisation on compatible coated items, and a corporate gifts line for teams, clients and special occasions. Its vinyl stickers service covers sharp, colourful custom stickers for products, packaging and events, while its custom acrylic work includes layered, etched and illuminated pieces made for a particular purpose. Across these lines the studio accepts small batches as well as larger production runs.

Vizi Solutions is a platinum-level Sage partner delivering ERP, business intelligence, cloud services and IT optimisation to clients in South Africa and Namibia. Alongside its Sage partnership, the company collaborates with Zap BI and Huawei, bringing in additional technology partners to widen the solutions it can offer clients. Its stated focus is on streamlining business operations, strengthening data analytics capabilities and optimising IT environments. Services span system integration for businesses running disparate systems, business process automation for organisations looking to streamline their processes, and cloud hosting. Rather than offering one fixed package, the company describes its approach as tailoring each engagement to a client's specific needs, whether that means integrating existing systems, automating processes or building on cloud infrastructure for future growth.

VRA Attorneys Pretoria Inc describes itself as a boutique law firm based in Pretoria, built around legal practitioners who focus on personalised attention for each client. Its practice areas cover commercial law, compliance and administrative law, litigation and alternative dispute resolution, estates and fiduciary services, family law, and notarial services. Although the firm is mainly based in Pretoria, it says it renders legal services to clients elsewhere in South Africa as well as internationally. The firm is open to negotiating payment arrangements that work for both sides, and says retainer arrangements are already in place with a number of its existing clients. The firm's stated focus is on innovative solutions tailored to each client's circumstances, rather than a one-size-fits-all approach to legal work.

items.description: Wannenburg's specialises in selling new and used motor spares for all makes and models of vehicle. It describes itself as the leading dismantler of accident-damaged motor vehicles, with over sixty years of experience in the new and used motor spares industry. As well as selling parts, the business buys and sells accident-damaged vehicles that are repairable, and it also sells rebuilds. The Paul Kruger Street branch in Mayville is one of four Wannenburg's branches across Pretoria, and the company presents its products as affordable without compromising on quality. It also offers a service for owners who need to sell their own vehicle quickly, helping them find the best way to maximise the return on a car they no longer want.

items.description: Waterware is a South African specialist supplier of water systems, irrigation, purification and plumbing infrastructure, operating brick-and-mortar branches in Centurion, Pretoria and Cape Town alongside a nationwide online store. Its pump range covers pressure-boost, borehole, submersible, drainage, sewage and fountain pumps as well as swimming pool pumps, while its irrigation line includes controllers, valves, sprinklers, drippers, fittings, filters, pipework and tanks. The business also stocks pool and spa equipment, from pumps and filters to automatic pool cleaners, lighting, pipework, fittings and chemicals, plus plumbing materials in PVC, copper, galvanised steel and HDPE. Beyond simply stocking products, Waterware offers irrigation system design, pump selection advice, and pump testing and repairs at selected stores, positioning its staff as a support team for customers building a system from scratch or upgrading an existing one.

WebBest designs and builds desktop and mobile applications for Android, iOS, Windows and macOS, along with custom progressive web applications intended to look good on any device. Its services are grouped under custom development, UX and UI, with a focus on tailor-made solutions aligned to each client's requirements. Native mobile apps for iOS and Android are developed by the company, which says it can deploy finished apps to the Apple App Store, the Google Play Store and the Huawei App Gallery. Desktop applications are built for Windows and macOS. Prospective clients are invited to book a consultation to discuss how the company can tailor its services to their specific business needs, and the website also presents a showcase of past work for reference.

WebDSL is a web design business in Theresapark with more than a decade of experience, and says it has produced award-winning projects. Its core offering is website design and online shop development, supported by web hosting on Linux and WordPress platforms and an email-only hosting option. The company also provides internet services, including fibre to the home and fixed LTE internet, and offers web security. Its design philosophy centres on meaningful content rather than placeholder text, arguing that carefully planned, purposeful layouts give a page more impact than generic filler. A portfolio of past projects is presented on the website so prospective clients can review the company's work before engaging it.

Whisk Cafe, in Monument Park, serves all-day breakfast and brunch alongside a pizza menu, fresh baked goods, and coffee and tea, with a takeaway range of snacks, breads and cakes. It trades from 7am to 9:30pm on Mondays and Tuesdays, extends to 10:30pm from Wednesday to Saturday, and keeps shorter Sunday hours from 8am to 4:30pm. For group orders, the cafe offers platter selections in large or small sizes, with large platters feeding roughly ten to twelve people and small platters feeding six to eight; these are intended as snack platters rather than full meals. A separate catering arm, branded as the Whisk Pantry, supplies specialised cakes, pastries, platters and home-cooked meal options for events, and asks for a 24-hour lead time on orders.

items.description: Wildebeest Air delivers professional HVAC, ventilation and air conditioning solutions throughout South Africa from its Pretoria base, covering commercial, industrial and specialised facilities. Founded in 2022, the company is built on decades of practical HVAC experience among its team, and is a BBBEE Level 3 compliant business. Its team designs smaller HVAC systems, selects suitable equipment for a facility's needs, and carries out professional installation, servicing and preventative maintenance rather than only one-off installs. Every project is tailored to the specific requirements of the facility involved, with the company saying its focus stays on comfort, efficiency, reliability and long-term performance. The business positions itself around building lasting client relationships through quality workmanship and dependable service, aiming to act as a long-term maintenance partner for the commercial and industrial clients it serves.

This Pretorius Street outlet trades under the nationwide Wimpy family-restaurant brand, which serves breakfast any time of day alongside a separate lunch menu for those wanting a lighter meal or a bigger, shared feast. A Burger Quiz feature on the brand's website helps undecided diners choose between a chicken or beef burger, or between a classic and one with all the toppings. The menu includes halaal options and allergen information for diners with dietary requirements. Families are catered for through Wimpy Playworlds, where children can play while adults finish their meals, and through edutaining crafts included with Kids' Combo Meals. The brand also offers themed birthday party bookings that include decor, invitations and a meal, letting parents hand off much of the planning for a child's celebration.

Windows Cleaning Projects offers window cleaning and maintenance to public and private clients, including commercial and residential buildings, office parks, car dealerships, and shopping complexes and malls. Its main technique is reach-and-wash cleaning using aluminium telepoles, which the company describes as a popular, safe and cost-effective method for regular cleaning. The business says it uses cleaning supplies and equipment that are safe and environmentally friendly, and describes its team as highly skilled, focused on timely results. Since it was established, the company has worked on projects with car dealerships and commercial and residential premises, including Hatfield VW, BB Nissan, Penta Suzuki, REAM Insurance and the Prosperitas building. The company says many of these clients still use its services on a monthly schedule rather than as a one-off clean.

Women Lead Fleet Management is a women-led fleet solutions company supplying GIANT, LANDINI and YTO tractors, as well as Giant and Maschio agricultural implements. Its plant equipment range includes GIANT plant equipment suited to construction and agricultural environments, and SINOMACH equipment for demanding construction and mining work. The broader range extends into attachments that expand machine versatility, forklifts for industrial and warehouse material handling, heavy-duty trucks, off-road utility vehicles and harvesters. The company frames its offering around strong leadership paired with smart, customer-focused fleet management, positioning itself as a reliable partner for businesses that depend on their equipment to keep operations moving.

Woodcentre was established in 1993 and has grown from a small board merchant in Johannesburg into a company with its head office in Johannesburg and a further branch in Pretoria, supplying the whole of South Africa and neighbouring countries through additional partners. Its product range includes melamine boards, high-pressure laminates, veneers, solid surfacing, MDF, chipboard, plywood and PVC board. Because the company does most of its own upgrading, it offers cut-and-edge services on wooden board products to customer specifications, runs its own foil and melamine plants so designs can be pressed onto a range of substrates, and carries out specialised veneering work using an experienced in-house team. The company says this in-house capability gives it a wider product range and more flexibility than most competitors, while it continues to prioritise honest trade and strong customer relationships.

items.description: Xnext supplies prepaid fibre and wireless internet with no fixed-term contracts, pitched around paying as you go rather than committing to a debit order or passing a credit check. Its residential offering covers both fibre and wireless connectivity, while a separate business line provides fibre connectivity aimed at enterprise customers. The company highlights real, local support for customers, and markets its connectivity around everyday uses such as video calls, streaming and online gaming. Alongside connectivity, Xnext also puts together small website packages for businesses, bundling a short, multi-page site with a period of hosting, a free domain and a set of email accounts into one once-off package. This combination of no-contract internet and bundled small-business web services positions the company as a single supplier for both connectivity and a basic online presence.

items.description: Yusra Tours was set up by a husband-and-wife team who specialise in Hajj and Umrah travel, though the agency says it can tailor-make a package to any destination globally rather than only pilgrimage travel. It positions itself around securing packages at competitive rates while still offering a full-service experience, including the selection of hotels, locations and sightseeing arrangements. The agency organises its destinations by region, covering Africa, Asia, Saudi Arabia, Europe and the Middle East. Having travelled extensively themselves, the founders say they bring that personal, first-hand experience into how each package is put together, aiming for a cost-effective yet comfortable trip for family and group travellers. The agency offers a guarantee of total satisfaction, including for the spouses and children who travel alongside the main booker.

items.description: Abode Real Estate is a residential estate agency whose team says it is committed to providing buyers and sellers with excellent service and a low-stress experience. The agency says it uses current technology to research and analyse the local market, helping clients make decisions based on up-to-date information. Its listings show the range of property it handles in and around Centurion and Pretoria, including a two-bedroom townhouse in Die Hoewes, a three-bedroom house in Rooihuiskraal, a three-bedroom townhouse in Val-de-Grace and a two-bedroom apartment in Amberfield. Beyond finding and listing properties, the agency offers bond pre-approval, property valuations and calculators, and provides market analysis for clients who want more detail before deciding.

ADB Energy Solutions is an electrical and solar company serving Centurion, Pretoria East, Hatfield, Menlyn and the wider Tshwane metro, offering SANS 10142-compliant electrical contracting alongside solar installation work. Its electrical services include system assessments, repairs and upgrades, phase balancing and load management for energy efficiency and safety, and the installation of lighting, switchgear and control systems, including smart electrical systems built for automation. On the solar side, the company designs hybrid and off-grid solutions, installs solar energy storage for uninterrupted power supply, and carries out energy audits aimed at identifying where solar integration would help most. The business issues COC certificates for completed electrical work and offers a 24/7 emergency callout service for both routine maintenance and larger solar projects.

Africa IT Distribution and Services, known as AIT, was founded in 2016 as a distributor of IT network solutions across Africa. The company works through strategic partnerships with technology vendors and a wider network of resellers who handle sales, technical support and services provision for the solutions it distributes. Its stated aim is to grow the number of transactions it supports across a broadening base of trusted partners in more African countries over time, framing its role as helping to accelerate digital transformation and economic development across the continent. The business describes its own culture around three values: being serious about responsibility, passionate about creativity, and determined about quality in how it operates. Based in Centurion, it continues to add new vendor relationships as it expands into further regions across Africa.

This Samrand branch of Agrinet forms part of a wholesale distributor that partners with, owns and distributes a range of brands across the hardware and irrigation markets. Agrinet organises its offering into fourteen specialist categories, so that each product area, from tools and plumbing to irrigation and agricultural supplies, is managed with dedicated focus rather than as one undifferentiated stock range. Many of the brands it stocks are described as exclusive or owned outright by the company, each screened and quality-tested before being added to the range, so that nothing leaves its facilities without its own stamp of approval. The business positions itself as a wholesale solutions partner for retail businesses, offering the convenience of buying across multiple categories from one supplier, backed by in-market teams, which it says helps retail partners save both cost and time.

AidaDias&Co provides online business manager and fractional chief operating officer services aimed at B2B founders who feel swamped by day-to-day administration. The company steps in as an operational partner, auditing messy internal systems, building clear standard operating procedures, and handling daily execution tasks so a founder can step back from constant task assignment and inbox management. Its services include systems audits, SOP creation, project management, team delegation, metric tracking and inbox triage, aimed at founders who hired a team to free up their time but ended up spending it checking work and chasing missed deadlines. The business describes its core values as clarity, translating complex operational problems into actionable steps, and no-nonsense execution, focused on hard work and honest results. Its stated mission is to let founders step out of day-to-day operational detail and focus on growing the business itself.

The Automotive Industry Development Centre, known as the AIDC, is a subsidiary of the Gauteng Growth and Development Agency, which is itself an agency of the Gauteng Department of Economic Development. It was established to strengthen the global competitiveness of the local automotive industry and to help position Gauteng as a preferred automotive industry destination. The AIDC works from the Automotive Supplier Park in Rosslyn, an industrial park spanning 130 hectares in the northern part of Pretoria that is home mainly to component manufacturers and suppliers to original equipment manufacturers. Through its Incubation Programmes, the AIDC supports Black-owned enterprises in the automotive sector during their start-up phases. The organisation says it has accelerated economic growth within the automotive industry through strategic partnerships with government and other stakeholders across the sector.

Air Service Centre distributes, installs and maintains compressed air systems, with a product range covering both piston compressors and screw compressors. Its air quality line covers refrigerant, absorption and filtration products as well as oil and water separators, helping condition the air in a system rather than only supplying compressors. The business also supplies receivers and advanced technology products, and it operates 24 hours a day so that breakdowns can be attended to outside normal business hours. With nearly two decades of experience in the industry, the company positions itself as covering the full lifecycle of a compressed air installation, from distribution and installation through to maintenance and repair.

items.description: Always Innovative Solutions is a digital innovation consultancy whose team spent twenty years in the digital innovation industry before changing direction to help other businesses grow. Its approach starts with a consultation to identify gaps and opportunities, followed by a comprehensive report with a project plan, timelines, milestones, a cost analysis and a schedule. The company also offers a suite of products to help clients reach those goals more quickly and smoothly. It is recognised as a Level 1 B-BBEE partner and is listed on the Central Supplier Database. Its product offering centres on search engine optimisation, Google Business Profile management and traffic services, with a focus on tangible, measurable outcomes achieved through digital tools and real-time analytics. Rather than taking on every client, the business says it is selective about who it works with so it can give each one the time and guidance it deserves.

Amex MultiSync helps both established and up-and-coming brands build identities that aim to create an emotional connection during product interactions, working across branding, UI/UX design, website development and app development. Its branding and identity service covers visual elements such as logos, colour palettes and typography, alongside brand voice and positioning, intended to help a business stand out in a crowded market. Website development is built around speed, responsiveness and a client's specific business goals, covering anything from a simple portfolio site to a full e-commerce platform or a larger corporate site, with attention paid to search-engine performance. Its UI/UX design work is described as human-centred, combining research with design to create digital experiences meant to engage users and drive conversions. The company also offers hosting as part of its overall digital services.

Amzo World is an international creative agency built to help businesses grow, working with both startups and larger companies that want to establish or strengthen an online presence. Its core offering includes building new websites designed to be attractive and high-performing without breaking the bank, alongside professional, branded email addresses intended to make a business instantly recognisable to its customers. The agency also works on brand identity, including logo design, for businesses wanting a fresh look. Its working process is built around three steps: first defining the target audience so communication is aimed at the right people, then prototyping ideas to test their usability and functionality, and finally presenting the completed work to the client for feedback. That process draws on research, questionnaires and customer reviews to understand what users actually respond to.
